description_en: Creates a chatbot by calling CreateBot
kebab_example: aliyun chatbot create-bot --language-code zh-cn --name test --api-version 2017-10-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBot

parameters.help_en: The language of the chatbot service, such as zh-cn or en-us
parameters.name: language_code

parameters.help_en: The name of the chatbot. The name can be up to 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 机器⼈名称，不超过50个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The URL of the chatbot avatar. The URL must be publicly accessible, such as an OSS resource URL. The URL can be up to 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 机器人头像URL，公网可用，比如OSS资源URL，长度不超过1024个字符
parameters.name: avatar

parameters.help_en: The description of the chatbot. The description can be up to 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 机器⼈备注，不超过50个字符
parameters.name: introduction

parameters.help_en: The type of the chatbot. Default value: scenario_im
parameters.name: robot_type

parameters.help_en: The business workspace key. If this parameter is not specified, the default business workspace is accessed. Obtain the key value from the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 业务空间key，不传时访问默认业务空间，key值在主账号业务管理页面获取
parameters.name: agent_key

InstanceId.description_en: The unique identifier of the chatbot
